metadata.owner_session: Bundle K-2 — Klinger × ISCO 2-digit recompute (magnitude upgrade)
metadata.supersedes_bundle: Bundle K (1-digit) — preserved as reference inside this file
metadata.data_source: lfsa_egai2d__custom_21241431_linear_2_0.csv (Eurostat LFS, employment by detailed occupation, ISCO-08 2-digit, 38 entities, 2011–2025)
metadata.granularity: ISCO 2-digit (43 codes; OC01..OC03, OC11..OC14, OC21..OC26, OC31..OC35, OC41..OC44, OC51..OC54, OC61..OC63, OC71..OC75, OC81..OC83, OC91..OC96)
metadata.aggregation_method_klinger_3to2: ESCO-occupation-count-weighted arithmetic mean of Klinger 3-digit coordination-shares within each OC2-digit parent. Default-fallback Klinger codes (n=5) carry weight=1 per Bundle K convention.
metadata.normalization_choice: Country raw 2-digit Klinger weight (Σ employment_share_oc2 × klinger_2digit_oc2) divided by cross-country mean to produce a multiplier centered on 1.0; preserves Phase 2 [0,1] interpretive scale and bucket thresholds (capability-floor breach proxy at 0.55). Same convention as Bundle K 1-digit.
metadata.velocity_source: Phase 1 displacement velocity carried forward unchanged (= current_lens5_ai_labour_load in Phase 2)
metadata.year_selection_rule: Latest year per country with coverage within ~4 codes of country-level maximum coverage (handles confidentiality suppression of small cells in recent years). LU forced back to 2022 (2025 has only 16/43 codes due to severe suppression). UK on 2019 (Eurostat ceased UK ISCO breakdown post-Brexit — same as Bundle K 1-digit). IS on 2024.

data_gaps.note: No country has full 43/43 OC2 coverage in selected year; suppressed cells (typically OC03, OC63, OC95, OC02) are small-employment categories. Employment shares renormalized on available codes (denominator = sum over present OC2 values per country). Underestimate from missing share is typically <1–2% of total employment by construction (suppressed cells are below Eurostat publication threshold).
data_gaps.li_proxy: LI uses CH data and year per Phase 2 convention (LI absent from lfsa_egai2d).

spot_check_de_1digit_reproduction.note: OC2-sum to OC1 reproduces K1d raw weight to 5 decimal places — engine validated.

sanity_test_high_coord_expected_up.interpretation: Bundle K hypothesis (high-coord countries underweighted at 1-digit) does NOT hold at 2-digit. Most sentinel-up countries show ATTENUATED positive deltas at 2-digit. CH/LI attenuates from +0.051 → +0.029. DE attenuates from +0.020 → +0.014. Only AT (+0.011 → +0.013) and IS (+0.040 → +0.062) and NO (+0.041 → +0.053) and DK (+0.024 → +0.033) and LU (+0.065 → +0.070) strengthen.

anti_sanity_test_low_coord_expected_down.interpretation: PL and RO ATTENUATE (less negative) at 2-digit; BG slightly amplifies; HR flips negative (was ≈0). The 2-digit reading dampens both ends of the K1d signal for the Visegrád/Balkan low-coord cluster.

spec_threshold_crossings_pm010.note: No country crosses spec ±0.10 substantive-change threshold (same as Bundle K 0/36).
